einzeiler: Comedian Nicki Glaser announces the final episode of her podcast after four years.
kurzfassung: Nicki Glaser announces in this final episode that her podcast is ending after four years due to her increasingly demanding schedule. Reflecting on her time on the show, she shares personal stories, including a stressful day when her dog went missing. Joined by co-hosts and former team members, she thanks her dedicated fans, known as besties, for their unwavering support.
stichpunkte: Nicki Glaser announces that this is the final episode of her podcast.
She cites an increasingly busy schedule and lack of energy as the reasons for ending the show.
Glaser recounts a stressful 13-hour ordeal when her dog Goldie went missing while she was traveling for comedy shows.
She expresses deep gratitude to her listeners, affectionately called besties, for their loyalty and open-mindedness.
The hosts discuss the unique freedom of performing comedy in Canada compared to the United States.
Former co-host Andrew calls into the show from New York to reminisce about the early days of the podcast.
Glaser reassures fans that she will continue to connect with them through stand-up and other future projects.
The episode concludes with heartfelt thank-yous to the production team, iHeart Podcasts, and Big Money Players.

kapitel.titel: The Big Announcement: The Final Episode
Andrew Calls In and Final Goodbyes

clips.text: A charming encounter with an elderly street musician playing bagpipes leaves an impression during a recent trip.
After discussing a fellow comedian's daring joke about the defense secretary, Nikki recounts traveling to Hartford for a weekend performance.

clips.hook: The best feeling in the world
clips.text: A preview for the podcast Solita explores the transformative personal growth that comes from traveling alone.
Nikki reflects on the guilt of telling dark jokes onstage, considering audience members who may be coping with severe grief such as the loss of a child.

clips.hook: Starting the show in the Cayman Islands
clips.text: As she steps away from the show, Nikki delivers a farewell to her podcast audience, inviting fans to continue seeing her on tour.

beschreibung:
Nikki really vibed with being in Canada this weekend and had a blast with her audience. Her shows in Hartford, CT, were emotional, finding out her dog Goldie went missing that morning. But don’t worry, it’s a happy ending! Sean and Emily, who were there for the whole thing, helped Nikki retell how she found out her pup was back in the middle of her performance. The Nikki Glaser Podcast also dropped a huge announcement that could take the Besties on an emotional ride, but Nikki did what she does best: showing her vulnerable side while adding her humor to a big life change. And Brian, Noa, Sean, and Emily are all super supportive and excited for her!
